resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS lists a 1914 alidade shelter. Oregon Lookouts lists a 1908 patrol lookout and a 1914 cupola-style lookout house. The story reports both.

FFLOS and firelookout.com give 5,750 ft. A 1939 Oregon Lookouts note gives 5,700 ft and a 1930 note gives 7,750 ft. The story uses the 5,750 ft register value because the two other figures are the outliers.

Oregon Lookouts spells the surname Nothiger in 1933 and 1936 and Nothinger in 1939. It gives the first name as Albeen in 1933 and Albyn in 1936. The story gives both first-name spellings and notes that the page spells the name more than one way.

notes_for_editor: The brief listed only the FFLOS 1914 alidade shelter; Oregon Lookouts gives a different 1914 structure and a 1908 patrol lookout, both now in the research. Access is set to public from the Forest Service trail page; the closure notice is generic. A worker at the station died in July 1945; two newspaper items differ on his age and on the cause (investigation open vs believed accidental). Left out of the story as not needed for the history; the editor may decide otherwise. No fires named in sources read. The FFLOS page carries a 1922-1938 photo credited to Edna Temple; no image URL was captured, so no photo entry.
